issues.title: [task] L6: four sap-shrines with Rot verses on floors 28, 33, 38 and 41

comments.body:
<!-- gemini-audit -->
**Gemini audit: spec**
_Gemini 4 Argon (high), a deep review because it is a spec, where a gap is cheapest to fix._

## #80

- [blocker] `src/content/cotw/index.ts:396-403` (and "Read first", `Floors`): The spec cites `src/content/cotw/index.ts:375-392` to claim no scripted vault sits on floors 28, 33, 38 or 41, stopping before lines 396–403 where `WORLD_BARK_FLOOR`, `URDR_POOL_FLOOR`, `VERDANDI_LOOM_FLOOR`, `RATATOSKR_ROOST_FLOOR` and `SKULD_MIRROR_FLOOR` are registered in `scriptedVaultPlacements`. In World-Bark Descent (floors 34–42), floors 34 (threshold), 35 (`galdr_altar_loki`), 36 (`floor36_matriarch_hollow`), 37 (`WORLD_BARK_FLOOR`), 39 (`galdr_altar_tyr`) and 40 (runestone 5 / Great Tap) are already occupied, leaving only 38, 41 and 42 for `VERDANDI_LOOM_FLOOR` and `RATATOSKR_ROOST_FLOOR` (`src/content/cotw/index.ts:400-401`, plus `URDR_POOL_FLOOR` in Silver Veins at `:399`). At least one of floors 28, 33, 38 and 41 already holds a Nornic reliquary scripted vault, contradicting `docs/sprint.md:207` ("no galdr or scripted floor") and the spec's placement premise.
- [blocker] `src/content/cotw/__tests__/spriteRecipes.test.ts:24-30` (and Acceptance criterion 5 / "Read first"): The spec dismisses `src/content/cotw/sprites/tiles.ts` ("that file holds terrain only") and places the shrine art only in `src/content/cotw/sprites/fixtureSprites.ts:31-51`, yet AC 5 requires that "every recipe key sits in one group (`spriteRecipes.test.ts`)". `src/content/cotw/__tests__/spriteRecipes.test.ts:24-30` checks `COTW_TILE_SPRITES` (`sprites/tiles.ts`) and `COTW_TERRAIN_SPRITES` (`sprites/terrain.ts`), not `COTW_FIXTURE_ART` (`sprites/fixtureSprites.ts`). If nothing is added to `src/content/cotw/sprites/tiles.ts` (`docs/sprint.md:209`), the `spriteRecipes.test.ts` clause in AC 5 passes vacuously without testing the shrine sprites.
- [note] `src/content/cotw/runestones.ts:90-96` (and Acceptance criteria 1, 3): Every `LoreEntryDefinition` in `SKALDIC_RUNESTONE_LORE` populates `flag`, `title`, `verse`, and `lore`. AC 1 and AC 3 specify `flag`, `title`, and `verse` for `SAP_SHRINE_LORE`, but do not specify what `lore` should hold (or whether `lore` is required by the schema/UI in the Story tab's Carved Verses when there is no runic spell hint).
- [note] Acceptance criterion 6 (and `src/content/cotw/index.ts:197`, `src/content/cotw/ironClans.ts:211-214`): AC 6 checks `cotwManifest` placements, tiles, and choices, and that choosing the option sets `sap_shrine_<n>_read` and logs the verse, but does not assert that `cotwManifest.loreEntries` includes the four `SAP_SHRINE_LORE` entries keyed by `sap_shrine_<n>_read` (AC 3) or that stepping on a shrine after reading it resolves via `resolvedStates` (AC 2).
- [note] Acceptance criterion 7 (and `docs/sprint.md:68`): AC 7 states "Only one line changes at each join point (`tiles.ts`, `choices.ts`, `index.ts` placements), plus the `loreEntries` line", omitting the required `import` lines in `src/content/cotw/tiles.ts`, `src/content/cotw/choices.ts`, and `src/content/cotw/index.ts` (and the four entries in `src/content/cotw/sprites/fixtureSprites.ts:42-44`). In `src/content/cotw/index.ts`, the import from `./sapShrines` should be placed adjacent to `./ironClans` rather than at the bottom of the import block so it does not conflict with lane `story`'s cherry-picks (`docs/sprint.md:68`).

Plan: Gemini point 1 (blocker) not applied: it is wrong. The scripted vaults sit on floors 13, 21, 22, 25, 30, 32 (Urdr), 36, 37, 39 (Verdandi), 42 (Ratatoskr), 45, 47 and 49 (`vaults.ts:7-30`, `index.ts:375-403`), and the galdr altars on 27, 31, 35, 39 and 43. None is on 28, 33, 38 or 41, so the placement holds.

Plan: Gemini point 2 (blocker) applied as a correction, not a block. `spriteRecipes.test.ts` doesn't read `COTW_FIXTURE_ART`, so AC 5 no longer leans on it; `fixtureSprites.test.ts` carries the check.

Plan: Gemini points 3-5 applied: each lore entry fills `lore` (required by `LoreEntryDefinition`). AC 6 now also checks `loreEntries` and `resolvedStates`. AC 7 allows the import lines, with `index.ts`'s next to `./ironClans`, and the fixture-art entries.

issues.title: [task] X3: An overburdened hero is told once to drop something

comments.body:
<!-- gemini-audit -->
**Gemini audit: spec**
_Gemini 4 Argon (high), a deep review because it is a spec, where a gap is cheapest to fix._

## #85

- [note] `src/engine/actions/movement.ts:52-60`, `src/engine/entities/player.ts:622-625` (Acceptance criterion 3): AC 3 states that the hint resets when "`canMove()` [is] true at the next movement attempt". If the transient "once" flag is only cleared inside `MovementAction.perform()` when `this.entity.canMove()` is true, a hero who drops items to clear `EncumbranceLevel.Immobilized` and then becomes immobilized again before taking a step (e.g., picking up another item, buying from a merchant, or taking from a container on the same tile) will never clear the flag and will not receive the hint on the next blocked step. Conversely, clearing the flag inside `Player.canMove()` would put a state mutation inside a query method. The flag should reset when encumbrance drops below `EncumbranceLevel.Immobilized` (or on weight-changing inventory actions) rather than waiting for a movement action.
- [note] `src/engine/entities/player.ts:622-625`, `src/engine/actions/movement.ts:52-59` (Acceptance criterion 1): `Player.canMove()` returns `false` both when `super.canMove()` is `false` (`src/engine/entities/player.ts:623`) and when `this.inventory.getEncumbrance(this.carryStrength) === EncumbranceLevel.Immobilized` (`src/engine/entities/player.ts:624`). If `MovementAction.perform()` checks only `!this.entity.canMove()` before logging the new drop-something hint, any non-encumbrance movement block from `super.canMove()` on the player would falsely tell the player their pack is overburdened.

Plan: Gemini point 2 applied: new AC 3a. The hint and the once-rule apply only when the block is the burden (`Immobilized`), never for another `canMove()` block.

Plan: Gemini point 1 not applied: if the hero clears the burden and is weighed down again before taking a step, they saw the hint a moment ago, so missing it once is harmless. Resetting on every inventory change spreads the transient state into pickup, shop and container code for no player gain.
Lane: re-queued, the previous lane session stopped.

Implementer: machine

`npm run gate-stamp -- run lint test tooling` failed twice with no code change in between, both times on timeouts only (lint passed; no assertion failed). The same test timed out both runs:

Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.

Run 1 had 6 timeouts in 5 other files (sprintGuard, campaignSeparation, chaosSimulation, entityIconSprite, portraitsAndScreens). Run alone, `chaosSimulation.test.ts` passes in 20.75 s, so this is load under the full suite. Free memory: 18877 MB, then 19458 MB, of 65160 MB.
